value.value: Figure 2A: MUA/MPA, 3/5/10 nm, 20/80/160 µg/mL, 24 h, mean ± SD, three independent experiments, p < 0.025. Figure 2B: AUT/CYST, 3/5/10 nm, 0.5/3.5/20 µg/mL, 24 h, mean ± SD, three independent experiments, p < 0.001. Red lines indicate media-control baseline. The positive-QD bar panels list 0.5/3.5/20 µg/mL in their legends/captions, but 5 and 10 nm CYST groups show only two bars; a 20 µg/mL result is not inferred for those groups.

value.value: Source describes stronger necrosis for positive QDs at lower doses; MPA shows no significant necrosis within the tested range. Table 4 preserves each nominal-size/ligand summary. p.9 describes 3 nm MUA as more necrotic than 5/10 nm; p.3/10 use a size-dependent-increase phrase without resolving direction. p.8 notes no necrosis for 3 nm AUT at 0.5 µg/mL or 3 nm CYST at the tested doses.

quality.review_scope: Independent review of all 15 main pages and consolidated correction delta accepted. SI and cited prior methods unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: No atomic-coordinate asset or crystallographic phase assignment reported in the scoped main text.
This is a biological characterization context, not an additional CdSe synthesis or structural pair.
No numerical bar/curve digitization; exact plotted evidence is retained as source crops.
The positive-QD bar panels list 0.5/3.5/20 µg/mL in their legends/captions, but 5 and 10 nm CYST groups show only two bars; a 20 µg/mL result is not inferred for those groups.
conflicts: Negative MUA/MPA: 20, 80, 160 µg/mL. Positive dose labels differ by assay/panel: general methods 0.5, 5, 20 µg/mL; Figures 2B, 3D, 4B, 5B use 0.5, 3.5, 20; Figure 3B images and Figures 5D/6 use their explicit labels. Never merge 3.5 and 5.
LDH method cites Martin et al.62; bibliography lists Martin as 61 and Gao as 62. Prior procedure not inspected.
General AUT toxicity wording is not interpreted as necrosis at every size/dose; specific low-dose exceptions retained.
